title: Ishwarapranidhana
one_line: Surrender to God: carrying out all actions without desiring their fruit, offering the fruit to the Lord.
points: Ishwarapranidhana means carrying out all our actions, spoken or unspoken, without desiring their fruit, and offering their fruit to the Lord.
Guruji quotes the great sages: whatever I do, whether out of desire or not, good or bad, having surrendered all that to you, I act as directed by you.
Through ishwarapranidhana, samadhi (union with the Supreme) is attained, which in turn leads to the attainment of perfection and fulfillment.

sutra.translation: The perfection of samadhi is due to the perfect alignment of attention with the omniscient seer within.
